cohort: Women presenting to labor emergency with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) at 32 to 34 weeks of gestation.
finding: Extended expectant management until 36 weeks for PPROM cases, compared to delivery at 34 weeks, safely improved perinatal outcomes by significantly increasing mean birth weight and reducing NICU stay, mechanical ventilation, neonatal jaundice, and necrotizing enterocolitis, without increasing maternal chorioamnionitis or other morbidities.
